text:
How reassuring.
Looks like they're
trying to be considerate
in their own way, huh?
Yeah...
Yes...
We're nearly at what we believe
to be their base.
Judging by the bandits' trail,
we should reach
their hideout soon.
WE ARE NEAR.
Hey, we're just
about to enter
their territory.
Hey, look!
A shipwreck...
Then the bandits
really are human?
A shipwreck...
Then the bandits
really are human?
That's hardly
the problem!
The problem is that flag
flying over there...
A bearded skull???
Whoa...
A bearded skull???
How tasteless.
What an absurd flag.
...
That's an embarrassing
flag, all right...
There's only one man
on these seas who'd fly
a flag that tacky...
I'm hungry...
Aye, Captain!
I could use a drink too...
Aye, Captain!
Oh, just as I thought.
It's Jakini's crew!
You know them?
Are they acquaintances of yours?
YOU KNOW THEM?
You know these guys?
They're pirates like us.
Much as I hate
to admit it...
For some reason,
they have a grudge
against our family.
They're always picking fights
and attacking us.
I see...
But what's a bunch of pirates
like them doing on this island?
But what are people like them
doing on this island?
Say, brother,
how long has it been
since we washed ashore here?
Well, brother,
it's been about
a month now.
A month, eh...
GRAAAH!
Why do we
have to put up
with all this!?
It's all because
we got caught in
that strange storm!
Who'd have thought a ship
tied up in port would be swept away
by a sudden storm...
And then end up
adrift at sea?
Nobody would expect that.
